absolute.description: Test the distance between the two points in 3D space.

horizontal.description: Test the distance between the two points, ignoring the Y value.

x.description: Test the absolute difference between the X-coordinates of the two points.

y.description: Test the absolute difference between the Y-coordinates of the two points.

z.description: Test the absolute difference between the Z-coordinates of the two points.

distance.description: To test the distance to the entity this predicate is invoked upon. Passes if the calculated distance is between the entered min and max, inclusive.

ambient.description: Test whether the effect is from a beacon.

amplifier.description: Test if the effect's amplifier matches an exact value. Level I is represented by 0.

duration.description: Test if the effect's remaining time (in ticks) matches an exact value.

visible.description: Test if the effect has visible particles.

null.description: A status effect that must be present.

effects.description: For testing the active [ [Effect|status effects] ] on the entity.

mainhand.description: Test the item in the entity's main hand.

offhand.description: Test the item in the entity's offhand.

head.description: Test the item in the entity's head armor slot.

chest.description: Test the item in the entity's chest armor slot.

legs.description: Test the item in the entity's legs armor slot.

feet.description: Test the item in the entity's feet armor slot.

body.description: Test the item in the entity's body armor slot.

equipment.description: For testing the items that this entity holds in its equipment slots.

is_baby.description: Test whether the entity is or is not a baby variant.

is_on_fire.description: Test whether the entity is or is not on fire.

is_sneaking.description: Test whether the entity is or is not sneaking.

is_sprinting.description: Test whether the entity is or is not sprinting.

is_swimming.description: Test whether the entity is or is not swimming.

flags.description: To test flags of the entity.

location.description: Test properties of this entity's location.

passenger.description: Test the entity directly riding this entity.

slots.description: Test properties of the block the entity is standing on, using a location predicate.

stepping_on.description: Test properties of the block the entity is standing on, using a location predicate.

team.description: Passes if the [ [Scoreboard#Teams|team] ] of this entity matches this string.

type.description: Test this entity's type. Accepts an [ [Data values/Entity IDs|entity ID] ].

targeted_entity.description: Test properties of the entity which this entity is targeting for attacks.

vehicle.description: Test properties of the vehicle entity that this entity is riding upon.

type_specific.description: To test entity properties that can only be applied to certain entity types. Supersedes lightning_bolt, player, fishing_hook and catType.
